description: This source file implements a plugin class 'RustAdapter' for the WPEFramework, which interfaces with Rust plugins either in-process or out-of-process. It contains plugin initialization, management, and communication handlers, including methods for attachment/detachment of channels, invoking remote procedures, and retrieving library paths and authentication tokens.

classes.name: RustAdapter
classes.description: The RustAdapter class acts as a plugin wrapper that manages Rust plugin instances, providing lifecycle management, communication, activation, and deactivation functionalities within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RustAdapter plugin based on configuration, setting up either a local or remote Rust plugin implementation.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns information about the plugin instance.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the plugin object.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and deletes the object when count reaches zero.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON RPC or callback invocation to the Rust plugin.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin, default for specific Thunder versions.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the plugin, default for specific Thunder versions.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the communication channel specified by channelId.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a security token for a method call.

methods.name: GetLibraryPathOrName
methods.description: Constructs a library path or filename based on provided name and callsign.

methods.name: GetAuthToken
methods.description: Retrieves an authentication token using the SecurityAgent interface.
